summary: Iteration 3 frontend-only retest of RevenueCat purchase flow (mobile 375x667, web preview). identityReady fix VERIFIED: new user -> /premium shows no 'Linking your account…', Subscribe enabled. Subscribe -> premium-confirm-modal -> Confirm -> purchases-js 'Test Store Purchase' dialog (Product: Pro monthly / pro.monthly, Price $9.99) -> 'Test valid purchase' -> success toast + router.back to dashboard. FOUND BUG: dashboard still showed 'Free Tier', 'Ads Today: 0 / 30', upgrade button visible right after purchase even though RevenueCat server had entitlement 'pro' active (verified via GET /v1/subscribers/{id}); only re-login showed Premium. RCA: purchaseMutation never wrote returned customerInfo into react-query cache and addCustomerInfoUpdateListener does not fire on web (purchases-js). Testing agent FIXED it (onSuccess setQueryData for purchase + restore) and re-verified with a fresh user: 'Premium Member' badge, 'Ads Today: 0 / 75', upgrade hidden, 'Manage Premium' visible, /premium shows premium-active. Price is STILL $9.99 (not $5.00) on premium screen, subscribe button and RC Test Store dialog. Minor fixes verified: watch button 'Ads in Android App Only' single line centered; admin ad overlay bg rgb(0,0,0) opaque; classic web tabs (tab-earn/tab-cashout) render and navigate. No deprecated packages detected (expo-router/native-tabs now used).

integration_issues.issue: FIXED by testing agent: after successful Test Store purchase UI stayed Free Tier (stale customer-info cache; listener not firing on web). Now setQueryData on purchase/restore success.

Dashboard button and copy say '$5/mo' -> mismatch. Re-upsert did not take effect; fix price in RevenueCat dashboard for the Test Store product.
